home.lead: Precious Steps has cared for Plainfield's children since 1998. Accredited, state rated, and small enough that we know every child by name.
home.heroImageSlot: Children at play in a classroom
home.storyTitle: Nearly thirty years of Plainfield families
home.storyP1: We began on the first floor of a two-family home, licensed for fifteen children. An early childhood contract with Plainfield Public Schools in 2000 let us serve more of our neighbors, and our waiting list for infants and toddlers grew past what one building could hold.
home.storyP2: Today we run two centers, accredited by the National Association for the Education of Young Children since 2006 and rated by Grow NJ Kids.
home.storyImageSlot: The center exterior or a classroom
home.teamTitle: Credentialed, bilingual, and here for the long run
home.teamP1: Our lead teachers hold BA, BS and MA degrees with standard Preschool through Third Grade certification, and several hold Special Education certification. Our associate teachers hold degrees and Child Development Associate credentials.
home.teamP2: Every staff member clears a Child Abuse Record Inquiry and a Criminal History Record Inquiry, is trained in CPR and First Aid, and takes part in continuous professional development. We have bilingual staff at the center.
home.programsLead: Five classrooms, each with its own curriculum and teacher to child ratio. High Scope for our youngest children, Connect 4 Learning in district Pre-K.
home.mealsTitle: Breakfast, lunch and snacks, every day
home.mealsP1: Meals are provided under the New Jersey Child and Adult Care Food Program and meet USDA nutritional standards, with menus posted monthly. We practice family style dining, where children and staff eat together and children serve themselves.
home.mealsP2: We accommodate food allergies as directed by your child's physician. Precious Steps is a nut free center.

about.title: About Us
about.description: Precious Steps Child Care Center has served Plainfield families since 1998. Our story, our philosophy, and the team caring for your child.
about.heroLead: What began on the first floor of a two-family home, licensed for fifteen children, is today two accredited centers serving infants through school age.
about.storyP1: Precious Steps was established in 1998, licensed for fifteen children. In 2000 we were awarded an early childhood contract through Plainfield Public Schools, which allowed us to offer early childhood education to resident children and families, and we moved to a larger facility licensed for forty-five children.
about.storyP2: Our reputation for caring for infants and toddlers grew our waiting list beyond what one building could hold, so we opened a second location dedicated to infants and toddlers. At the same time we began pursuing accreditation through the National Association for the Education of Young Children. It was an arduous process, and we have been accredited since 2006.
about.storyP3: In 2007 we acquired the facility and contracted classrooms of a child care program that was closing, increasing our Pre-K enrollment to 120. In 2013 we accepted an invitation to participate in Grow NJ Kids, the state quality rating initiative, which put every policy and procedure under review. That work earned us 4 of 5 stars at Arlington Avenue and 3 of 5 stars at Washington Avenue.
about.philosophyQuote: From birth, a baby's brain cells multiply wildly, making connections that may shape a lifetime of experience. The first five years are critical.
about.philosophyP1: That idea is the cornerstone of our philosophy. Growth and development do not happen by chance. They are achieved through planned and spontaneous interactive learning experiences that stimulate the senses and foster development physically, cognitively, socially, emotionally, and creatively.
about.philosophyP2: In partnership with our parents, we provide a warm and nurturing setting reminiscent of a child's most natural environment, home. There are opportunities for solitary play as well as group activities, and our staff serve as positive role models offering care that is supportive and responsive to each child's individual needs.
about.antibiasP1: We work to promote and create an inclusive environment that encourages conversations among children and adults about difference, without judgement. It is our goal that all of our children and their families feel respected, included, and reflected in our early childhood classrooms.
about.directorTodo: Director biography is drafted from the questionnaire. Confirm the preferred name, title and level of personal detail with the client before publishing, and obtain a headshot.
about.directorP1: Our director began her career in early childhood education in 1984 at a Head Start program in Jersey City, having just earned a BA in Psychology with a concentration in Child Development and a minor in Business Management.
about.directorP2: Her work with children facing developmental challenges carried her through early intervention programs in New York and New Jersey, a rehabilitative program in Atlanta serving medically fragile children, and finally the role of New Jersey Central Regional Special Needs Coordinator, before she became the owner and operator of Precious Steps.
about.directorP3: That experience shapes the center to this day. Precious Steps consistently welcomes children with special challenges and ensures that they and their families feel supported. Families are frequently referred to us by the district for exactly that reason.
about.teachersIntro: Our teaching team holds degrees and credentials across early childhood education and special education.
about.teachersLeadDetail: BA, BS and MA degrees, standard Preschool through Third Grade certifications, Certificates of Eligibility with Advanced Standing, and Special Education certification.
about.teachersAssocDetail: BA, BS, AA degrees and Child Development Associate credentials.
about.teachersInfantDetail: AA degrees and Child Development Associate credentials.
about.teachersOutro: All staff clear a Child Abuse Record Inquiry and a Criminal History Record Inquiry, are trained in CPR and First Aid, and participate in continuous professional development. We have bilingual staff at the center.

programs.title: Programs
programs.description: Infant, toddler, preschool and school age programs at Precious Steps in Plainfield, NJ, with age ranges, teacher to child ratios and curricula.
programs.heroLead: We use the High Scope curriculum with our infants, toddlers and Room to Bloom children, and Connect 4 Learning in our district Pre-K classrooms. Both are built around active, hands-on learning.
programs.mealsP1: Meals and snacks are provided under the New Jersey Child and Adult Care Food Program and meet USDA nutritional standards. Menus are posted monthly. We practice family style dining, where children and staff eat together at the table and children serve themselves from appropriately sized bowls and pitchers.
programs.mealsP2: We accommodate food allergies as directed by your child's physician. Precious Steps is a nut free center.
programs.tripsP1: We provide transportation for field trips. Parents sign a blanket permission slip at registration for walks and visits in the community, and a trip-specific permission slip for any outing requiring transportation away from the center.
programs.touchP1: We use Brightwheel as our primary communication platform, with ClassDojo also in use. Meals, diaper changes and daily activities are posted by teachers each day, and parent teacher conferences are held three times a year.

enrollment.title: Enrollment
enrollment.description: How to enroll at Precious Steps in Plainfield, NJ. Tour, application, documents, subsidies and what to expect, step by step.
enrollment.heroLead: Enrollment starts with a conversation and a visit. Here is what the process looks like from your first call to your child's first day.
enrollment.documentsNote: An updated copy of your child's immunization record must be given to the center after each doctor visit.
enrollment.subsidiesExtra: We will help you request or transfer yours during enrollment.
enrollment.safetyP1: Both centers have secure entrances, cameras throughout, and burglar and fire alarms, and we run regular fire and intruder drills. All staff clear a Child Abuse Record Inquiry and a Criminal History Record Inquiry and are trained in CPR and First Aid.
enrollment.safetyP2: Our full health policies, including when to keep a child home, medication procedures and our discipline philosophy, are set out in the Parent Handbook.

steps.detail: Call the center or send us a message through this website. Tell us your child's name and age and when you would like to visit.

steps.title: Schedule a visit

steps.title: Tour and talk
steps.detail: You will see the classrooms, meet the team, review our philosophy, and ask anything you like. We will discuss your child's needs, habits, and development.

steps.title: Complete the application
steps.detail: We will walk you through the enrollment paperwork and the documents we need on file.

steps.title: Arrange assistance if needed
steps.detail: If you are using a childcare subsidy or an assistance program, we will help you request or transfer it.

steps.title: Confirm your start date
steps.detail: Submit the deposit with your start date and the initial tuition, and your child's first day is set.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: How Precious Steps Child Care Center handles the information you send through this website.
privacy.heroLead: How we handle the information you send us through this website.
privacy.reviewTodo: This is a plain-language starting point written to match how the site actually behaves. Have the client read it and confirm it is accurate for their operation before launch.
privacy.scopeBody: This notice applies to this website. It does not cover the information we collect on paper during enrollment, or information handled inside Brightwheel or ClassDojo, which have their own terms.
privacy.collectP1: If you fill in the tour request form, we receive what you type into it: your name, phone number, email address, your child's first name and age if you choose to give them, the program you are interested in, a preferred visit date, and your message.
privacy.collectP2: Please do not send medical details, diagnoses, or any government identification numbers through this form. Those belong on the enrollment paperwork we complete with you in person.
privacy.useBody: We use it to answer your enquiry and arrange a visit. We do not sell it, rent it, or share it with anyone outside the center for marketing.
privacy.whereBody: Form submissions are delivered by our website host to the center's email inbox and are retained in the host's submission records. The site is served over an encrypted connection.
privacy.cookiesP1: This website sets no advertising or analytics cookies of its own and loads no analytics trackers.
privacy.cookiesP2Before: Our Locations and Home pages embed maps from Google Maps so you can see where each center is. Google may set cookies and record your IP address when one of those maps loads, under
privacy.cookiesP2After: . Everything the maps show is also written out as plain text on the page, so you never need to interact with them.
privacy.childrenBody: This website is written for parents and guardians. It is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect information submitted by a child.
privacy.photosBody: Photographs of enrolled children appear on this site only where a signed publicity release is on file. If you would like your child's image removed, contact us and we will take it down.
privacy.contactAfter: or call either location with any question about this notice, or to ask us to delete an enquiry you have sent.

infant.name: Infants
infant.summary: A calm, home-like room with cribs, age appropriate toys, and comfortable rocking chairs, where every baby gets individualized attention and plenty of cuddle time.
infant.schedule: Each infant follows their own schedule. The day includes napping, eating, diapering, quiet play, and outside time.

toddler.name: Toddlers
toddler.summary: A nurturing room where children are encouraged to use their words, and where learning happens through play, projects, and hands-on activities.
toddler.schedule: A daily routine built around exploration, play, and early language. A daily sheet goes home with changes, meals, and nap times.

district-prek.name: District Pre-K
district-prek.summary: A state approved preschool program aligned with the New Jersey Preschool Teaching and Learning Standards, delivered in partnership with Plainfield Public Schools.
district-prek.schedule: Arrival, breakfast, circle time, morning message, read aloud, learning centers, small group, outdoor play, lunch, nap, snack, read aloud, learning centers, dismissal.

faq.q: How do parents hear about their child's day?
faq.a: We use Brightwheel as our primary communication platform, with ClassDojo also in use. Meals, diaper changes, and daily activities are posted by teachers each day.

faq.q: Does my child need to be potty trained?
faq.a: No. Children who are not potty trained receive support with diapering and potty training skills. The absence of potty training does not exclude a child from our program.

faq.q: Do you welcome children with special needs?
faq.a: Yes. Precious Steps has a long history of welcoming children with special challenges and supporting their families.
We follow Plainfield Public Schools closings. For specific information, call the center between 6:00 AM and 7:00 AM for a recorded message.

faq.q: When should I keep my child home?
How quickly will you respond to my inquiry?
faq.a: Within 24 hours Monday through Friday. Weekend inquiries are answered the next business day.
